title: Sharks Replace Lost Teeth for Life
title_hook: Sharks Replace Lost Teeth for Life
description: Sharks continuously replace teeth throughout life. In spotted ragged-tooth sharks, one study measured about 1.06 teeth shed per day and estimated over 13,500 across a lifetime. Source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8070439/
narration: Sharks can replace lost teeth throughout their entire lives. Behind the front row, several rows of replacement teeth are already waiting. Each time a tooth drops, the next row moves forward. One study tracked spotted ragged-tooth sharks losing about 1.06 teeth a day. That pace can add up to over 13,500 teeth in a lifetime.
facts: Sharks continually replace teeth throughout their lives.
Several rows of replacement teeth wait behind the front row.
Spotted ragged-tooth sharks lose about 1.06 teeth per day, yielding over 13,500 in a lifetime.
